title_as_printed: Experimental results of methane water content at elevated temperatures
pressure_note: equilibrium cell pressure (+-0.7 bar), held constant during sampling by hydraulic fluid behind the piston; absolute or gauge not stated

T.constant: set by group_rows (block header 'T = 150 C +-0.1 C' etc.)

value.what: water content (y_w, ppm by volume) of the methane-rich gas phase

skip_rows.reason: temperature block label rows and 'AAD %' summary rows

extra_unmapped: AAD % CPA / PC-SAFT per block (authors' model deviations)
notes: Side-by-side blocks (150, 100, 50 C) stacked left first. Each printed water content carries a '+-x.xx%' entry; the '+-' and '%' were moved to the header and the number written in its own column. Method (text pp.143-146, 162): 600 ml titanium piston cell in a Chandler PVT oven, >=24 h equilibration, sample through a heated line (200 C) and heated six-port valve to an HP 5890 GC (TCD for water and CO2, FID for methane; Poropak-Q column; calibration in number of moles, Figs 4.8-4.10). Text says 34.5 to 827.4 bar, but the 50 C block starts at 27.6 bar (as printed).
